prompts.text: Re-attempt after the KB audit: two of three claimed walls were sound, the third was unmeasured algebra. Told to MEASURE, not derive.

quarantine_reason: ONLY WALL 1 SURVIVES: capacity. 80 QR invocations x 17 measured cells = 1360 against a 120-cell array, so a straight-line unroll does not fit and the design must reuse one datapath across passes. Walls 2 and 3 from the first quarantine do NOT bind: wall 2 was refuted by measurement (see notes), and wall 3 (HOP_CNT/DEST are immediates) is a true ISA fact that does not apply here because the ChaCha permutation is NOT data-dependent. Not shipped because 37 authored cells are individually proven but NOT WIRED (no build_cell_programs/internal_connections/default_layout), so the assembled block does not compute. Remaining work is wiring + fold + harness - architecture, not unknowns.
notes:
THE HEADLINE: THE PREVIOUS QUARANTINE'S WALL 2 WAS FALSE, AND THIS IS THE POINT OF THE WHOLE AUDIT. It claimed 'the state cannot transit a cell at all', deriving a W<=10 ceiling from INV-45's 3W+1 formula. Never run. Measured on the real placed+routed chip: a STREAMING relay (one word in, same word out, holding nothing) costs a CONSTANT 3 instructions at any frame width, and carries frames of 8/10/12/16/24/32/64/128 words BIT-EXACT through 1 and 3 cells. W=32 is the full ChaCha20 state - the exact case the claim declared impossible. W=128 is TWELVE TIMES the claimed ceiling.

The 3W+1 bound is real but prices only the HOLD-ALL-IN-REGISTERS relay, and even for that shape it is W<=9, not W<=10 (at 10 the inequality holds with equality, leaving zero words, and still collides). So the number being used to size a future architecture was both over-scoped AND off by one. LAYER: a property of a CODE SHAPE - not hardware, not toolchain - so it is avoidable by writing a different relay. Gated by test_wide_transit_ceiling.py (38 tests) + a new TransitProbeBlock.

WALL 3 REASSESSED: the permutation is not data-dependent at all. All 80 invocations are ten identical repeats of a fixed 8-step cycle, and every quadruple takes exactly one word from each of the four rows. With a row per lane cell the 4k term is WHICH CELL (static routing) and only the 2-bit within-row selector is computed, via LOAD [Rn]. NO SRAM PANEL NEEDED - which deletes the entire integration surface that sank the first attempt.

MEASURED ON CHIP THIS PASS: recirculation over one datapath at 1/2/4/8/10/20/80 passes, exact every time; the lane cell reading via LOAD-indirect and writing back via a 4-way CMP/BR (the ISA has NO STORE [Rn]) correct for all 32 (row, half, selector) combinations on the real RFC state; the sequencer emitting all 80 RFC schedule invocations exactly; and the shipped ChaCha20QRBlock sustaining all 80 sequential invocations bit-exact.

NEW GOTCHA GATED: counter DIRECTION is load-bearing. A descending j gives j&3 = 0,3,2,1 and silently computes a DIFFERENT CIPHER while still producing exactly 80 invocations - no count-based or structure-based check catches it.

IT DID NOT COMMIT THE BLOCK SOURCE, deliberately: shipping a non-computing block was the previous attempt's fault. INV-47 corrected IN PLACE (twice), stating the old text and the reach, per the new evidence rule; new INV-49 on datapath reuse.

THE METHOD NOTE, VERBATIM, BECAUSE IT IS THE LESSON OF THIS ENTIRE EPISODE: 'every "cannot" in the previous quarantine that was DERIVED was wrong; every one that was MEASURED held.'

ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION: 38 transit tests pass; the W=32 and W=128 cases are real parametrized on-chip runs, not model assertions; 130 tests green from main.
